method: 24 deterministic Dot renders: eight unchanged licensed photos, levels 0/0.5/1, same 400x500 mm canvas and settings. Detail blends the existing local area sample with a sample at 0.4 times its radius; broad edge emphasis is unchanged. Subject masking is off. This is a software comparison, not semantic segmentation or measured likeness, noise reduction, comfort or print validation.
timingScope: One local Node render per variant; excludes decode/export. Order is 0,0.5,1 per source and is not randomized/warmed. Timings are diagnostic, not a browser/mobile performance guarantee.
